profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Bloomberg
profile.summary: Object oriented software engineer and relational database professional with extensive skills in collaboration, programming, and data analysis. Proficient in Java, JavaScript, Python, Oracle, and Microsoft SQL. Excel in analyzing data relations and offer custom solutions to satisfy both company and client request. Very strong communication skills and have the ability to adapt to different environments.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
Developed API and helped design communication layer for all asset transfers between and E*TRADE and Morgan Stanley applications using SOAP & RESTful service calls with Java’s Spring framework

Managed team of 3 developers, held daily scrums calls, and delegated tasks in optimal order for all E*TRADE and Morgan Stanley integration work to meet required deadlines

Designed and implemented new hire on-boarding process and development training plan for 30 new developers reducing development on-boarding process from 2.5 months to 4 weeks

Provided quarterly forecasts to project managers and stakeholders for E*TRADE’s asset transfer division based on developer bandwidth, required deadlines, and integration tasks

Consulted product owners and operations teams in weekly integration calls to provide insight on design feasibility and project impact analysis mitigating downstream

Gathered requirements to request infrastructure for amount of RAM, nodes, and load balancers needed to handle daily traffic for asset transfer requests coming through
positions.insights: Skills: Sybase SQL Anywhere · Java · XML · Spring Framework · XSL

positions.title: Application Development Consultant
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development and design of dynamic Java action using SOAP and RESTful web services and Java DOM Parser that interfaced LIMS applications with multiple external systems which automated and decreased Procter and Gamble’s data creation process from hours to seconds

Fast tracked and helped lead 6-month COVID-19 testing implementation in 6 weeks which allowed Procter and Gamble employees to scan, ship, and process health results in 2 days

Designed and created high-level tracking system in LIMS application for the US Army to replace their existing system, reducing errors and increasing efficiency by 100% 

Trained new employees and interns to use company’s custom Java API and LIMS application and distributed project level tasks to accelerate their growth

Cleansed, mapped, and migrated client databases to Oracle and Microsoft SQL server allowing clients to use their existing data with company’s LIMS application

Assumed role of business analyst and gathered customer requirements, drafted functional requirement documentation, and wrote test scripts for builds delivered to customers

Managed all databases across multiple virtual machines for all product development and testing and configured JBoss servers to host application for multiple projects

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
Developed Microsoft SharePoint web application using Java’s Spring framework and REST API which allowed users to manually launch and shutdown virtual machines for specified time periods through Amazon Web Services, saving the company $35,000 a month

Automated 42 test cases for company’s operational quality testing team using Tricentis Tosca automation software increasing testing consistency and reliability

positions.title: Database Engineer Intern
positions.description: Designed and implemented a Microsoft Access database for the educational department to track all member, university, and shipment information which increased member processing and data retrieval by 400%

volunteerExperiences.description:

•	Good communication skills with parents, supervisors, and fellow associates
